tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because predict referenced an undefined _TRAIN_ROWS variable. This replacement fits the documented two-layer siphon base against the three plausible branch terms using all paid rows, then predicts from the fitted parameters. The broad sink-gradient span makes an additional branch probe unnecessary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient range is broad (0.25 to 2.2), so the archive's low-gradient-span trigger for this probe is not met; fit competing branch forms directly.
The pilot signatures and available input variation support the static two-layer siphon family; no trajectory or memory-state ambiguity is indicated.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target response and is explicitly not worth purchasing.

considered_alternatives.option: Static quadratic, logistic, or single-factor Michaelis models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These omit the observed sink-gradient dependence and are less consistent with the supplied pilot signature.
